'''Naley Frifa''' was a multi-talented [[outlaw tech]] and [[tattoo]] [[artist]] who was a patron of [[the Lodge]] on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]] in [[10 BBY]]. While there, she watched [[sabacc]] being played in one of the back rooms, witnessing the [[Gambling|gambler]] [[Han Solo]] arrive and then eventually be bested by his opponent [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]].

==Biography==
The [[human]] Naley Frifa worked as an [[outlaw tech]] and a [[tattoo]] [[artist]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Rarely out-of-work, she made illegal modifications and repairs to [[starship]]s or equipment and inked both gang symbols and [[electro-tattoo]]s capable of carrying data.<ref name="SoloOG" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the portion of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' set on [[Vandor]] to [[10 BBY]].</ref> Frifa was a patron of [[the Lodge]], a [[saloon]] in [[Fort Ypso]] on the [[Water|icey]] [[planet]] [[Vandor]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

[[File:Han-Lodge-360.png|thumb|right|300px|Naley Frifa (right) watched Han Solo (center) play sabacc at the Lodge.]]
While at the Lodge, Frifa was part of a crowd that watched a game<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> of [[Corellian Spike]]<ref name="SoloOG" /> [[sabacc]] being played on a table in one of the venue's backrooms. She was stood with drink in hand besides another human and a pillar when [[Han Solo]], a new addition to the game, first took his seat directly in front of her. The tattoo artist then continued drinking and chatting with other patrons by the pillar as Solo played a number of rounds, eventually [[Gambling|betting]] his [[starship]] against [[Millennium Falcon|that]] of his opponent [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="Solo" /> Frifa leaned on the pillar as she and the rest of the crowd watched the table intently, cheering<ref name="Solo360">{{SWYouTube|YnJqQfYRTEo|Solo: A Star Wars Story 360}}</ref> when Solo revealed [[straight staves]], before Calrissian revealed a [[Full Sabacc]] and won the round.<ref name="Solo" />

==Personality and traits==
Naley Frifa had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and tan skin. She had a stylised depiction of a [[hyperspace]] [[simu-tunnel]] tattooed in black across her torso, with other black tattoos on her [[Limb|arms]] including the word "Hiro" in [[High Galactic]] on her left forearm.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Skills and abilities==
Frifa was multi-talented and was skilled at tattoo artistry, adept in both gang symbols and electro-tattoos.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Equipment==
While at the Lodge, Frifa wore a dark blue [[jumpsuit]] with light brown ribbing around the waste and sleeves, with a brown [[belt]], and black [[boot]]s.<ref name="Solo360" /> On her right arm she wore a golden bangle and on her right she wore a white and brown bracelet, with a black fingerless glove on her left hand. She also had her [[Mouth|lips]] colored black and black eye-shadow on while at the venue.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Lain Freefall- Naley Frifa. Close enough ''😁'' it's official and to my knowledge the first tattooist in Star Wars. Thank you universe. I'm actually still in shock.|L'ain Freefall|<ref name="Instagram">{{Instagram|username=lainfreefall|url=p/BjQEu6YHM0p|name=[[L'ain Freefall]]|quote=Lain Freefall- Naley Frifa. Close enough 😁 it's official and to my knowledge the first tattooist in Star Wars. Thank you universe. I'm actually still in shock.|archivedate=20201217033036}}</ref>}}
Naley Frifa was portrayed by [[Wikipedia:British Chinese|British-Chinese]] actress and tattoo artist [[L'ain Freefall]]<ref name="Heritage">
{{Instagram|username=lainfreefall|url=p/BkLPXeOHl8A|name=L'ain Freefall|date=2018-06-18|quote=I've always been very proud of being (British)Chinese. It's natural in our culture to remain stoic, not show too much emotion that may cause a negative reaction. When we are hurt or angry, we are raised to let our work do the talking. This is why I'm so happy to be part of something so big. I am different, in most cases, I would be shunned even in my own culture for looking the way I do and choosing my line of work as a tattooer. I am a woman, a person of colour and a creative. #communicatingthroughanxiety #starwarstattooartist #geometrictattoo #femaletattooartist #yourbearingshapesyourfate #womenempowerment #womenofcolor #unite #pride #solo #starwars|archivedate=20230604015905}}</ref> in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="SoloOG" /> which was released on the [[May 25]], [[2018]]. The character was revealed prior to the release of the film in "Solo: A Star Wars Story 360," a promotional video posted by the official ''Star Wars'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] account on [[May 4]], 2018.<ref name="Solo360" /> She was first identified in the reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released alongside the film.<ref name="SoloOG" /> Frifa's name is a partial anagram of Freefall's, and the actress was pleased with the role<ref name="Instagram" /> and proud of taking part in something as big as ''Star Wars'' as a woman of color.<ref name="Heritage" />
